overview: CLASSROOM HUB is a shared class homework site where students sign in, request access, and manage homework, timetables and announcements together.
features: Sign in with Internet Identity and request access
Admin approval of registrations with Admin and Student roles
Dashboard with welcome message, task statistics and an interactive daily timetable
Interactive month, week and day homework calendar with Daily and Subject views
Permanent homework history with search and filters
Submit homework and suggest edits with Pending, Approved and Rejected statuses
Class announcements published by the admin
Admin console for approving registrations, homework and edit suggestions
Persistent shared data with server-side permissions
